name: MBD4-related Tumor Predisposition Syndrome

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Proposed Diagnostic Criteria for MBD4-related Tumor Predisposition Syndrome

criteria.description: Presence of a pathogenic or likely pathogenic germline variant in the MBD4 gene
Development of multiple colorectal adenomas or colorectal carcinoma at a young age
Family history of colorectal or other MBD4-associated tumors in first-degree relatives
Somatic loss of MBD4 function or characteristic mutational signature in tumor tissue

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of a pathogenic germline MBD4 variant plus at least one major clinical feature (multiple colorectal adenomas or colorectal carcinoma)
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is confirmed by genetic testing; clinical features may vary and some carriers may be asymptomatic.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Somatic MBD4 loss-associated mutational signature in tumors
searchTerms: mutational pattern linked to MBD4 deficiency
acute cancer of myeloid blood cells

common.symptomName: Gastrointestinal bleeding due to polyps or tumors
searchTerms: bleeding from gut polyps or tumors

common.symptomName: Abdominal pain related to tumor growth
searchTerms: stomach or belly pain from tumor

occasional.symptomName: Anemia secondary to chronic gastrointestinal bleeding
searchTerms: low blood count from chronic bleeding
anemia caused by ongoing GI blood loss
blood deficiency due to gut bleeding

occasional.symptomName: Fatigue related to anemia or malignancy
searchTerms: fatigue linked to low blood or malignancy
weakness due to illness or anemia
frequent diarrhea or changed bowel movements
loose stools and bowel habit changes

rare.symptomName: Leukopenia or thrombocytopenia due to bone marrow involvement
searchTerms: blood cell deficiencies from marrow disease
weakened immune system from blood cancer
low immunity from bone marrow cancer

rare.symptomName: Ocular symptoms related to uveal melanoma (e.g., visual disturbances)
searchTerms: vision changes due to uveal tumor

laboratory: Detection of pathogenic germline MBD4 variants by genetic testing
Anemia and cytopenias on complete blood count
Somatic mutational signature indicative of MBD4 loss in tumor sequencing
imaging: Imaging studies (CT/MRI) showing colorectal tumors or metastases
Ocular imaging identifying uveal melanoma lesions
other: Family history of colorectal or hematological malignancies
Histopathological confirmation of colorectal adenomas and carcinomas

distinguishingFeatures: Mismatch repair gene mutations (MLH1, MSH2, MSH6, PMS2) instead of MBD4
Microsatellite instability rather than MBD4-specific mutational signature
Earlier onset colorectal cancer with characteristic family history
Hundreds to thousands of colorectal polyps compared to fewer in MBD4 syndrome
Distinct extracolonic manifestations such as desmoid tumors

redFlags: Early-onset colorectal carcinoma with multiple adenomas
Family history of colorectal or hematological malignancies
Detection of pathogenic germline MBD4 variant
references: Wang Y et al. Germline MBD4 mutations and predisposition to colorectal cancer and acute myeloid leukemia. Nat Genet. 2021.
